market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $75,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: BTC ~$78,800 with 24h low already $78,329. To dip to $75,000 (LOW) in May requires only ~4.8% from spot. In a high-vol month with 27 days remaining and BTC recently near $80k psychological resistance, a 5% dip is highly probable; monthly intraday lows often print 5%+ below period highs.
assessment.key_uncertainty: If BTC breaks out strongly above $80k it could avoid revisiting $75k entirely.
